sources.snippet: The model, named "t5-small," is pre-trained on a diverse corpus of text data, enabling it to capture essential information and generate meaningful summaries. Fine-tuning is conducted with careful attention to hyperparameter settings, including batch size and learning rate, to ensure optimal performance for text summarization.

sources.snippet: AI Text Summarizer is a Natural Language Processing (NLP) application that generates concise and meaningful summaries from long pieces of text using a fine-tuned T5-small Transformer model. The application provides a simple web interface where users can input large text passages and receive high-quality abstractive summaries in real time.

sources.snippet: T5-Small is a lightweight variant of the Text-To-Text Transfer Transformer (T5), designed to handle a wide range of NLP tasks using a unified text-to-text approach. Developed by researchers at Google, this model reframes all tasks—such as translation, summarization, classification, and question answering—into the format of input and output as plain text strings.
